subject: [PATCH 25/60] mm/mempolicy: queue only common memory for mbind() and migrate_pages()

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series is a necessary step towards further changes in the memory policy code. It correctly identifies and addresses issues with ZONE_DEVICE checks.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series modifies the memory policy (mempolicy) code to queue only common memory for mbind() and migrate_pages(). The change involves converting ZONE_DEVICE checks to use folio_is_common_memory(), which allows skipped folios not to count as failures. This is done in preparation for further changes.
